# asana

## ASANA_ADD_FOLLOWERS_TO_PROJECT
Tool to add followers to a project in Asana. Use this tool when you need to add one or more users as followers to a specific project. Followers will receive notifications when tasks are added to the project.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddFollowersToProjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_gid",
    "followers"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "followers": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Followers",
      "examples": [
        "521621,621373",
        "me",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "A string identifying users. These can either be the string \"me\", an email, or the gid of a user. For multiple followers, use a comma-separated string."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "followers",
          "name",
          "archived"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides \"pretty\" output. Provides the response in a \"pretty\" format. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    },
    "project_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1331"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the project."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_ADD_FOLLOWERS_TO_TASK
Tool to add followers to a task in Asana. Use this tool when you need to add one or more users as followers to a specific task. This will notify them of updates to the task.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddFollowersToTaskRequest",
  "required": [
    "task_gid",
    "followers"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "task_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1202599807151278"
      ],
      "description": "The globally unique identifier for the task."
    },
    "followers": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Followers",
      "examples": [
        [
          "12345",
          "67890"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "An array of user GIDs to add as followers to the task. For example: [\"12345\", \"67890\"]."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "followers",
          "assignee"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include. For example [\"followers\", \"assignee\"]."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides \u201cpretty\u201d output. Provides the response in a \u201cpretty\u201d format. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_ADD_ITEM_TO_PORTFOLIO
Add a project (or other supported item) to an Asana portfolio using the native addItem endpoint. Use when a workflow needs to attach a newly created project to a portfolio without using ASANA_SUBMIT_PARALLEL_REQUESTS.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddItemToPortfolioRequest",
  "required": [
    "portfolio_gid",
    "item"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "item": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Item",
      "examples": [
        "1202599807151278",
        "1234567890123456"
      ],
      "description": "The globally unique identifier (GID) of the item to add to the portfolio. Typically a project GID, but can be any supported portfolio item type. Must be a numeric string."
    },
    "insert_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert After",
      "examples": [
        "1202599807151278"
      ],
      "description": "GID of a portfolio item after which to insert the new item. Mutually exclusive with `insert_before`."
    },
    "insert_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert Before",
      "examples": [
        "1202599807151278"
      ],
      "description": "GID of a portfolio item before which to insert the new item. Mutually exclusive with `insert_after`."
    },
    "portfolio_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Portfolio Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1202599807151278",
        "1234567890123456"
      ],
      "description": "The globally unique identifier (GID) of the portfolio to add the item to. Must be a numeric string."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "AddItemToPortfolioResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AddItemToPortfolioResponse",
      "required": [
        "data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "data": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Data",
          "properties": {},
          "description": "Empty data object confirming successful addition of item to portfolio.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      }
    },
    "AddItemToPortfolioResponseData": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AddItemToPortfolioResponseData",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Empty response data object returned upon successful item addition to portfolio.\n\nAsana returns an empty data object {} for this endpoint on success.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "title": "AddItemToPortfolioResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "data": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Data",
          "properties": {},
          "description": "Empty data object confirming successful addition of item to portfolio.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_ADD_MEMBERS_TO_PROJECT
Tool to add users to a project in Asana. Use this tool when you need to add one or more users as members to a specific project. Members can view and contribute to the project.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddMembersToProjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_gid",
    "members"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "members": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Members",
      "examples": [
        "521621,621373",
        "me,user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "An array of strings identifying users. These can either be the string \"me\", an email, or the gid of a user. For example: \"521621,621373\" or \"me,user@example.com\"."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "members",
          "name",
          "archived"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include. For example: [\"members\", \"name\", \"archived\"]."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides \"pretty\" output. Provides the response in a \"pretty\" format. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    },
    "project_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1331"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the project."

  }
}

## ASANA_ADD_PROJECT_FOR_TASK
Tool to add a project to a task in Asana. Use when you need to associate a task with a project. Optionally position the task within the project using insert_before, insert_after, or section parameters.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddProjectForTaskRequest",
  "required": [
    "task_gid",
    "project"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "project": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project",
      "examples": [
        "1210474562469922"
      ],
      "description": "The globally unique identifier for the project to add to the task."
    },
    "section": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Section",
      "examples": [
        "987654"
      ],
      "description": "A section in the project to insert the task into. The task will be inserted at the bottom of the section unless combined with `insert_before: null` (end of section) or `insert_after: null` (beginning of section). Can also be combined with non-null `insert_before` or `insert_after` to position relative to a task within the section."
    },
    "task_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1213196740913610"
      ],
      "description": "The globally unique identifier for the task to add a project to."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' output. Provides the response in a 'pretty' format. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    },
    "insert_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert After",
      "examples": [
        "124816"
      ],
      "description": "A task in the project to insert the task after, or `null` to insert at the beginning of the list. When used with `section`, `null` will insert at the beginning of the specified section, otherwise the task must be in the specified section."
    },
    "insert_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert Before",
      "examples": [
        "432134"
      ],
      "description": "A task in the project to insert the task before, or `null` to insert at the end of the list. When used with `section`, `null` will insert at the end of the specified section, otherwise the task must be in the specified section."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "AddProjectForTaskResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AddProjectForTaskResponse",
      "required": [
        "data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "data": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Data",
          "properties": {},
          "description": "Empty data object confirming successful addition of project to task.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      }
    },
    "AddProjectForTaskResponseData": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AddProjectForTaskResponseData",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Empty response data object returned upon successful project addition to task.\n\nAsana returns an empty data object {} for this endpoint on success.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "title": "AddProjectForTaskResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "data": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Data",
          "properties": {},
          "description": "Empty data object confirming successful addition of project to task.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",

## ASANA_ADD_SUPPORTING_RELATIONSHIP
Tool to add a supporting goal relationship to a goal. Use when you want to link a project, task, portfolio, or another goal as a supporting resource to a specific goal in Asana.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddSupportingRelationshipRequest",
  "required": [
    "goal_gid",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "supporting_resource"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "insert_after": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Insert After",
          "examples": [
            "abcdef"
          ],
          "description": "The GID of an existing supporting resource. If provided, the new supporting resource will be placed after this one."
        },
        "insert_before": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Insert Before",
          "examples": [
            "67890"
          ],
          "description": "The GID of an existing supporting resource. If provided, the new supporting resource will be placed before this one."
        },
        "contribution_weight": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Contribution Weight",
          "maximum": 1,
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "A number between 0 and 1 (inclusive) representing the weight of the supporting resource's progress towards the goal's progress."
        },
        "supporting_resource": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Supporting Resource",
          "examples": [
            "12345"
          ],
          "description": "The GID of the supporting resource (project, task, portfolio, or goal) to link to the goal."
        }
      },
      "description": "The request data for adding a supporting relationship.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "goal_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Goal Gid",
      "examples": [
        "98765"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the goal."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "description": "This endpoint returns a compact resource, which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides \u201cpretty\u201d output. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_ADD_TAG_TO_TASK
Tool to add an existing tag to a task in Asana. Use when you need to add a tag for prioritization, routing, or automation workflows. Tags cannot be added via Update Task, so this dedicated endpoint is required.

**Input schema:**

    "tag_gid"

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tag Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The globally unique identifier for the tag to add. The tag must already exist in the workspace."
    },
    "task_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1202599807151278"
      ],
      "description": "The globally unique identifier for the task."

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [

      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Limited utility for this endpoint as it returns an empty data block."

      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",

}

## ASANA_ADD_TASK_DEPENDENCIES
Tool to add dependency relationships to an Asana task. Use when you need to mark one or more tasks as prerequisites (dependencies) for another task, ensuring the dependency tasks must be completed first.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddTaskDependenciesRequest",
  "required": [
    "task_gid",
    "dependencies"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "task_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1202599807151278"
      ],
      "description": "The globally unique identifier for the task that will depend on other tasks."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        "name,assignee,dependencies,due_on"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. By default, the response returns a compact representation of the task. Use this to retrieve additional fields such as 'name', 'assignee', 'due_on', 'dependencies', etc."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' output. Provides the response in a 'pretty' format with proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    },
    "dependencies": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Dependencies",
      "examples": [
        [
          "123456789012345",
          "987654321098765"
        ]
      ],
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "An array of task GIDs that the target task depends on (i.e., these tasks must be completed before the target task can be started). Each GID should be a valid task identifier."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_ADD_TASK_TO_SECTION
Adds an existing task to a section, optionally positioning it before or after another task in that section; if no position is specified, the task is added to the end.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddTaskToSectionRequest",
  "required": [
    "section_gid",
    "task_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "task_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task Gid",
      "pattern": "^\\d+$",
      "examples": [
        "1202599807151278",
        "1234567890123456"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the existing task to add to the section. Must be a numeric string."
    },
    "section_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Section Gid",
      "pattern": "^\\d+$",
      "examples": [
        "1202599807151278",
        "1234567890123456"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the target section. Must be a section GID (not a project or task GID). Use GET_SECTIONS_IN_PROJECT to retrieve valid section GIDs from a project."
    },
    "insert_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert After",
      "pattern": "^\\d+$",
      "examples": [
        "1202599807151278"
      ],
      "description": "GID of a task in the section after which to insert the current task. Mutually exclusive with insert_before."
    },
    "insert_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert Before",
      "pattern": "^\\d+$",
      "examples": [
        "1202599807151278"
      ],
      "description": "GID of a task in the section before which to insert the current task. Mutually exclusive with insert_after."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_CREATE_ALLOCATION
Creates a new allocation. Use when you need to schedule or assign a specific amount of a user's time per week to a task or project within a defined period.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateAllocationRequest",
  "required": [
    "workspace_gid",
    "assignee_gid",
    "effort_type",
    "effort_value",
    "start_on",
    "end_on"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "notes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Notes",
      "examples": [
        "Allocation for Q3 feature development"
      ],
      "description": "Any additional notes related to the allocation."
    },
    "end_on": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End On",
      "format": "date",
      "examples": [
        "2024-08-22"
      ],
      "description": "The end date of the allocation. The format is YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "start_on": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start On",
      "format": "date",
      "examples": [
        "2024-08-15"
      ],
      "description": "The start date of the allocation. The format is YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "effort_type": {
      "enum": [
        "hours",
        "percent"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Effort Type",
      "examples": [
        "hours",
        "percent"
      ],
      "description": "The unit type for tracking effort on the allocation. Must be either 'hours' or 'percent'."
    },
    "project_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Gid",
      "examples": [
        "111222"
      ],
      "description": "The project GID for which this allocation is being made. If provided, the allocation will be linked to this project."
    },
    "assignee_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assignee Gid",
      "examples": [
        "67890",
        "me"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the user to whom the allocation is assigned. This can be the user's GID or the string 'me' to refer to the authenticated user."
    },
    "effort_value": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Effort Value",
      "examples": [
        2,
        50
      ],
      "description": "The numeric effort value for the allocation. Represents hours per week if effort_type is 'hours', or percentage if effort_type is 'percent'.",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0
    },
    "workspace_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the workspace where the allocation will be created."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_CREATE_A_PROJECT
Creates a new Asana project in the specified workspace. Requires a `workspace` GID, and additionally a `team` GID if the workspace is an organization.

GREEN = 3\n\nAccess them by:\n\n- attribute access::\n\n>>> Color.RED\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- value lookup:\n\n>>> Color(1)\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- name lookup:\n\n>>> Color['RED']\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\nEnumerations can be iterated over, and know how many members they have:\n\n>>> len(Color)\n3\n\n>>> list(Color)\n[<Color.RED: 1>, <Color.BLUE: 2>, <Color.GREEN: 3>]\n\nMethods can be added to enumerations, and members can have their own\nattributes -- see the documentation for details."

GREEN = 3\n\nAccess them by:\n\n- attribute access::\n\n>>> Color.RED\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- value lookup:\n\n>>> Color(1)\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- name lookup:\n\n>>> Color['RED']\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\nEnumerations can be iterated over, and know how many members they have:\n\n>>> len(Color)\n3\n\n>>> list(Color)\n[<Color.RED: 1>, <Color.BLUE: 2>, <Color.GREEN: 3>]\n\nMethods can be added to enumerations, and members can have their own\nattributes -- see the documentation for details."

GREEN = 3\n\nAccess them by:\n\n- attribute access::\n\n>>> Color.RED\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- value lookup:\n\n>>> Color(1)\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- name lookup:\n\n>>> Color['RED']\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\nEnumerations can be iterated over, and know how many members they have:\n\n>>> len(Color)\n3\n\n>>> list(Color)\n[<Color.RED: 1>, <Color.BLUE: 2>, <Color.GREEN: 3>]\n\nMethods can be added to enumerations, and members can have their own\nattributes -- see the documentation for details."

GREEN = 3\n\nAccess them by:\n\n- attribute access::\n\n>>> Color.RED\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- value lookup:\n\n>>> Color(1)\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- name lookup:\n\n>>> Color['RED']\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\nEnumerations can be iterated over, and know how many members they have:\n\n>>> len(Color)\n3\n\n>>> list(Color)\n[<Color.RED: 1>, <Color.BLUE: 2>, <Color.GREEN: 3>]\n\nMethods can be added to enumerations, and members can have their own\nattributes -- see the documentation for details."

## ASANA_CREATE_A_TAG_IN_A_WORKSPACE
Creates a new tag, with properties like name and color defined in the request body, within a specific Asana workspace (using `workspace_gid`); this tag helps categorize tasks, is confined to the workspace, and is not automatically applied to tasks.

## ASANA_CREATE_A_TASK
Creates a new Asana task; requires 'workspace', 'parent', or 'projects' for association, and 'followers', 'projects', 'tags' are set only at creation.

## ASANA_CREATE_ATTACHMENT_FOR_OBJECT
Tool to upload an attachment or link an external resource to a task, project, or project_brief in Asana. Use when you need to attach a file or external URL to any Asana object.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateAttachmentForObjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "parent"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://docs.composio.dev"
      ],
      "description": "The URL of the external resource being attached. Required for attachments of type 'external'. Mutually exclusive with 'file'."
    },
    "file": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "Required for 'asana' attachments. This field should be provided when uploading a file. Mutually exclusive with 'url'.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Composio Documentation"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the external resource being attached. Required for attachments of type 'external'. For file uploads, this is optional and will be derived from the file if not provided."
    },
    "parent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent",
      "examples": [
        "1212826719445794"
      ],
      "description": "Required identifier of the parent task, project, or project_brief, as a string. This is the GID of the object to attach the file or URL to."
    },
    "connect_to_app": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Connect To App",
      "description": "Optional. Only relevant for external attachments with a parent task. A boolean indicating whether the current app should be connected with the attachment for the purposes of showing an app components widget. Requires the app to have been added to a project the parent task is in. This property can only be set if an OAuth token is used to authenticate the request."
    },
    "resource_subtype": {
      "enum": [
        "asana",
        "external"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "ResourceSubtypeEnum",
      "examples": [
        "external",
        "asana"
      ],
      "description": "The type of the attachment. Must be 'asana' for file uploads or 'external' for URL attachments. If not specified, a file attachment of type 'asana' will be assumed. Note that if the value is 'external', 'name' and 'url' must also be provided."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_CREATE_ATTACHMENT_FOR_TASK
Tool to upload an attachment to a task. Use when you need to attach a file to a specific task in Asana.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateAttachmentForTaskRequest",
  "required": [
    "parent_gid",
    "file"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "The file to upload.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "parent_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the parent task or comment."
    },
    "connect_to_app": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Connect To App",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Whether to connect the attachment to the app. If true, the attachment will be displayed in the Asana UI as an app attachment. If false, the attachment will be displayed as a regular file attachment. Defaults to true."
    },
    "resource_subtype": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Resource Subtype",
      "examples": [
        "asana"
      ],
      "description": "The type of the attachment. Must be one of the given values. If not specified, a regular file attachment will be created. If 'asana' is specified, the attachment will be a link to another Asana task. If 'external' is specified, the attachment will be a link to an external resource. If 'gdrive' is specified, the attachment will be a link to a Google Drive file. If 'box' is specified, the attachment will be a link to a Box file. If 'dropbox' is specified, the attachment will be a link to a Dropbox file. If 'vimeo' is specified, the attachment will be a link to a Vimeo video."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_CREATE_CUSTOM_FIELD
Tool to create a new custom field in a workspace. Use when you need to define a new field for tracking specific information within Asana tasks.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCustomFieldRequest",
  "required": [
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "workspace",
        "resource_subtype",
        "name"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "The name of the custom field."
        },
        "format": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Format",
          "description": "The format of this custom field."
        },
        "precision": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Precision",
          "maximum": 6,
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Only relevant for custom fields of type `Number`. The number of places after the decimal to round to (0-6)."
        },
        "workspace": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Workspace",
          "description": "The workspace to create a custom field in."
        },
        "description": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Description",
          "description": "The description of the custom field."
        },
        "custom_label": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Custom Label",
          "description": "String that appears next to the custom field value if `format` is `custom`."
        },
        "enum_options": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "EnumOption",
            "required": [
              "name"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "name": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Name",
                "description": "The name of the enum option."
              },
              "color": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Color",
                "description": "The color of the enum option."
              },
              "enabled": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Enabled",
                "description": "Whether the enum option is enabled."
              }
            }
          },
          "title": "Enum Options",
          "description": "Only relevant for `enum` or `multi_enum`. Specifies possible values."
        },
        "add_to_folder": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Add To Folder",
          "description": "A folder GID to add the custom field to."
        },
        "currency_code": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Currency Code",
          "description": "ISO 4217 currency code if `format` is `currency`."
        },
        "add_to_projects": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Add To Projects",
          "description": "A list of project GIDs to add the custom field to."
        },
        "resource_subtype": {
          "enum": [
            "text",
            "enum",
            "multi_enum",
            "number",
            "date",
            "people"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Resource Subtype",
          "description": "The type of the custom field."
        },
        "custom_label_position": {
          "enum": [
            "prefix",
            "suffix"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Custom Label Position",
          "description": "Where to place the custom label if `format` is `custom`."
        },
        "has_notifications_enabled": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Has Notifications Enabled",
          "description": "Whether a follower of a task with this field should receive inbox notifications from changes to this field."
        }
      },
      "description": "The custom field object to create.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "gid",
          "name"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Provides \u201cpretty\u201d output."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_CREATE_ENUM_OPTION_FOR_CUSTOM_FIELD
Tool to create a new enum option for a custom field in Asana. Use this when you need to add a new selectable option to an existing custom field.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateEnumOptionForCustomFieldRequest",
  "required": [
    "custom_field_gid",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "name"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "High"
          ],
          "description": "The name of the enum option."
        },
        "color": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Color",
          "default": "none",
          "examples": [
            "blue"
          ],
          "description": "The color of the enum option. Defaults to none. Accepts a string representing the color, e.g., 'blue', 'red', 'green'."
        },
        "enabled": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Enabled",
          "default": true,
          "description": "Whether the enum option is enabled. Defaults to true."
        },
        "insert_after": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Insert After",
          "examples": [
            "12345"
          ],
          "description": "An existing enum option GID after which the new enum option should be inserted."
        },
        "insert_before": {
          "type": "string",

## ASANA_CREATE_PROJECT_BRIEF
Tool to create a project brief for a project. Use when you need to add a detailed explanation (what and why) to a project.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateProjectBriefRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_gid",
    "html_text"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "html_text": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Html Text",
      "examples": [
        "<body>This is the project brief content.</body>",
        "<body>Testing project brief creation with status code verification.</body>"
      ],
      "description": "Rich text content wrapped in HTML body tag. The content must be wrapped in a <body> tag, e.g., '<body>Project brief content here</body>'."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include. Available options: html_text, permalink_url, project, project.name, text, title"
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' output. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    },
    "project_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1331",
        "1210474562681601"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the project."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_CREATE_PROJECT_FOR_TEAM

  "type": "object",

      "title": "Data",

          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "Q4 Marketing Campaign",

          ],
          "description": "Name of the project to create. Should be a concise, descriptive title."

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Color",
          "examples": [
            "light-green",
            "dark-blue"
          ],

          "type": "string",

          "examples": [
            "me",

## ASANA_CREATE_PROJECT_FOR_WORKSPACE
Tool to create a project in a workspace. Use when you need to create a new project within a specific Asana workspace. Note: The team field is required when creating projects in workspaces.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateProjectForWorkspaceRequest",
  "required": [
    "workspace_gid",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "team"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "Q4 Marketing Campaign",
            "Website Redesign Project"
          ],
          "description": "Name of the project to create. Should be a concise, descriptive title."
        },
        "team": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Team",
          "examples": [
            "1210548708279955",
            "159874"
          ],
          "description": "Team GID where the project will be created. Required when creating a project in a workspace. The team must exist in the workspace."
        },
        "color": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Color",
          "examples": [
            "light-green",
            "dark-blue"
          ],
          "description": "Color of the project in Asana UI. Common values include 'light-pink', 'light-green', 'light-blue', 'dark-blue', 'dark-purple', etc."
        },
        "notes": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Notes",
          "examples": [
            "Project to launch the Q4 marketing campaign across all channels."
          ],
          "description": "Free-form text description providing details about the project."
        },
        "owner": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Owner",
          "examples": [
            "me",
            "1234567890123456"
          ],
          "description": "User GID of the project owner. Use 'me' for the current user or a specific user GID."
        },
        "due_on": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Due On",
          "examples": [
            "2024-12-31",
            "2025-06-30"
          ],
          "description": "Due date for the project in YYYY-MM-DD format."
        },
        "public": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Public",
          "examples": [
            true,
            false
          ],
          "description": "Whether the project is public to the organization. Public projects are visible to all organization members."
        },
        "archived": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Archived",
          "examples": [
            false
          ],
          "description": "Whether the project should be archived upon creation. Archived projects are hidden from most views."
        },
        "start_on": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Start On",
          "examples": [
            "2024-01-01",
            "2025-01-15"
          ],
          "description": "Start date for the project in YYYY-MM-DD format. If set, due_on must also be provided and be different from start_on."
        },
        "followers": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Followers",
          "examples": [
            [
              "1234567890",
              "9876543210"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "List of user GIDs to follow the project."
        },
        "default_view": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Default View",
          "examples": [
            "list",
            "board",
            "timeline"
          ],
          "description": "Default view for the project. Options: 'list', 'board', 'calendar', 'timeline', 'gantt'."
        },
        "custom_fields": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Custom Fields",
          "examples": [
            {
              "1234567890": "value1",
              "9876543210": "value2"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Custom fields for the project as key-value pairs. Keys are custom field GIDs, values depend on the field type.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        }
      },
      "description": "Project data payload containing the project details to create.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "name",
          "notes",
          "owner",
          "team.name",
          "workspace.name"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of optional field names to include in the response (e.g., 'name', 'notes', 'owner', 'team.name', 'workspace.name'). By default, some properties are excluded."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' output with proper line breaking and indentation for debugging. Note: increases response size and processing time."
    },
    "workspace_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1205766922013215",
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the workspace or organization where the project will be created."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_CREATE_PROJECT_STATUS_UPDATE
Tool to create a new status update on a project. Use when you need to communicate the current status, progress, or any blockers related to a specific project.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateProjectStatusUpdateRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_gid",
    "title",
    "text",
    "status_type",
    "color"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "text": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Text",
      "examples": [
        "<h1>Weekly Update</h1><p>We are on track to complete the deliverables by end of next week.</p>"
      ],
      "description": "The HTML content of the status update."
    },
    "color": {
      "enum": [
        "GREEN",
        "YELLOW",
        "RED",
        "BLUE",
        "COMPLETE"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Color",
      "examples": [
        "GREEN"
      ],
      "description": "Color of the status update. Supported values: GREEN, YELLOW, RED, BLUE, COMPLETE."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "examples": [
        "Project Alpha Status - Week 5"
      ],
      "description": "The title of the project status update."
    },
    "project_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the project."
    },
    "status_type": {
      "enum": [
        "on_track",
        "at_risk",
        "off_track",
        "on_hold",
        "complete"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status Type",
      "examples": [
        "on_track"
      ],
      "description": "The type of status. Must be one of: on_track, at_risk, off_track, on_hold, complete."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_CREATE_SECTION_IN_PROJECT
Creates a new SECTION (not a task) in a project. Sections are organizational containers within a project used to group and categorize tasks (e.g., 'To Do', 'In Progress', 'Done', 'Backlog'). The new section can be optionally positioned relative to an existing section in the same project. IMPORTANT: This action creates SECTIONS only. Do NOT use this action to create tasks. To create a task, use the ASANA_CREATE_A_TASK action instead. Task-related fields like 'assignee', 'notes', 'due_date', 'description' are NOT supported by this action.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateSectionInProjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_gid",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "To Do",
        "In Progress",
        "Done",
        "Backlog",
        "Completed"
      ],
      "description": "Name for the new section. This is a section name (e.g., 'To Do', 'In Progress'), NOT a task name."
    },
    "project_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1210473471812630",
        "67890"
      ],
      "description": "GID of the project where the section will be created. Must be a valid project GID."
    },
    "insert_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert After",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "67890"
      ],
      "description": "GID of an existing section to insert the new section after; if omitted (and `insert_before` is also omitted), the new section is added at the end."
    },
    "insert_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert Before",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "67890"
      ],
      "description": "GID of an existing section to insert the new section before; if omitted, the new section is added at the end."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a section in a project.\n\nNOTE: This action creates SECTIONS only, NOT tasks. Sections are organizational\ncontainers within a project used to group tasks (e.g., 'To Do', 'In Progress', 'Done').\nDo NOT pass task-related fields like 'assignee', 'notes', 'due_date', etc.\nTo create tasks, use the ASANA_CREATE_A_TASK action instead.",
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

## ASANA_CREATE_STATUS_FOR_OBJECT
Tool to create a status update on a project, portfolio, or goal. Use when you need to communicate progress, blockers, or current state to all followers of an object.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateStatusForObjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "parent",
    "text",
    "status_type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "text": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Text",
      "examples": [
        "Project is progressing well. All milestones on track."
      ],
      "description": "The text content of the status update. This is the body of the status update that will be sent to all followers of the parent object."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "examples": [
        "Weekly Status Update"
      ],
      "description": "The title of the status update. If not provided, Asana may auto-generate a title based on the status_type."
    },
    "parent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent",
      "examples": [
        "1210124791807961"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier (GID) of the object to create a status update on. Can be a project, portfolio, or goal GID. GIDs are long numeric strings (e.g., '1210124791807961')."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "gid",
          "title",
          "status_type",
          "created_at",
          "author.name"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of optional field names to include in the response. Common fields include: gid, title, text, status_type, created_at, created_by, author, parent, resource_subtype, html_text, etc."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' JSON output with line breaks and indentation. Useful for debugging; may increase response time and size."
    },
    "status_type": {
      "enum": [
        "on_track",
        "at_risk",
        "off_track",
        "on_hold",
        "complete"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status Type",
      "examples": [
        "on_track"
      ],
      "description": "The type of status update. Must be one of: on_track (project is on track), at_risk (project is at risk), off_track (project is off track), on_hold (project is on hold), complete (project is complete)."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_CREATE_SUBTASK
Creates a new Asana subtask under an existing parent task (`task_gid`); `due_on` and `due_at` are mutually exclusive and cannot be set simultaneously.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateSubtaskRequest",
  "required": [
    "task_gid",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Complete subtask",
        "Review section"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the subtask to be created."
    },
    "notes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Notes",
      "examples": [
        "This subtask involves reviewing section 2.1",
        "Update documentation for this component"
      ],
      "description": "Optional descriptive text for the subtask."
    },
    "due_at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Due At",
      "examples": [
        "2024-03-15T14:00:00Z",
        "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"
      ],
      "description": "Optional due date and time for the subtask in ISO 8601 format (e.g., YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ), which is more specific than `due_on`."
    },
    "due_on": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Due On",
      "examples": [
        "2024-03-15",
        "2024-12-31"
      ],
      "description": "Optional due date for the subtask in YYYY-MM-DD format, representing the end of the day for the task."
    },
    "assignee": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assignee",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890123456",
        "me"
      ],
      "description": "User to assign to this subtask. Accepts either a numeric user GID (e.g., '1234567890123456') or the special value 'me' for the authenticated user. If not provided, the subtask will be unassigned."
    },
    "task_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task Gid",
      "pattern": "^\\d+$",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "67890"
      ],
      "description": "The numeric Global ID (GID) of the parent task under which the subtask will be created. Must be a numeric string (digits only). Special values like 'me' are not accepted."
    },
    "completed": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Completed",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Optional flag to mark the subtask as completed upon creation. Defaults to false if not specified."
    },
    "followers": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Followers",
      "examples": [
        [
          "12345",
          "67890"
        ],
        [
          "98765"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Optional array of user Global IDs (GIDs) to add as followers to the subtask. Followers receive notifications about subtask updates."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_CREATE_TAG
Tool to create a new tag in an Asana workspace. Use when you need to create a tag for categorizing tasks. Tags help organize and filter tasks across projects but are not automatically applied to any tasks.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTagRequest",
  "required": [
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "workspace"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "Important",
            "Q1 2024",
            "High Priority"
          ],
          "description": "The name of the tag. This should be a short, descriptive name that will be visible in the UI."
        },
        "color": {
          "enum": [
            "dark-pink",
            "dark-green",
            "dark-blue",
            "dark-red",
            "dark-teal",
            "dark-brown",
            "dark-orange",
            "dark-purple",
            "dark-warm-gray",
            "light-pink",
            "light-green",
            "light-blue",
            "light-red",
            "light-teal",
            "light-brown",
            "light-orange",
            "light-purple",
            "light-warm-gray"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "ColorEnum",
          "examples": [
            "light-green",
            "dark-blue"
          ],
          "description": "Color of the tag from predefined Asana color options. If not specified, Asana will assign a default color."
        },
        "notes": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Notes",
          "examples": [
            "This tag is used to mark critical items."
          ],
          "description": "Free-form textual information or description associated with the tag."
        },
        "followers": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Followers",
          "examples": [
            [
              "1210124065021206",
              "1210124065021207"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "An array of user GIDs who should follow this tag. Followers receive notifications for changes to the tag."
        },
        "workspace": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Workspace",
          "examples": [
            "1205766922013215"
          ],
          "description": "The workspace or organization GID where this tag will be created. Once created, tags cannot be moved to a different workspace."
        }
      },
      "description": "The properties for the tag to be created.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "name",
          "color",
          "workspace.name"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of field names to include in the response. Common fields: color, created_at, followers, name, notes, permalink_url, workspace."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "If true, provides pretty-printed JSON response. Useful for debugging but may increase response size."
    }
  }
}

    "text"

      "description": "The plain text content of the comment to be posted on the task. HTML or rich text is not supported via this field."

      "title": "Task Id",
      "examples": [

}

## ASANA_GET_ALLOCATIONS
Tool to get multiple allocations. Requires either 'parent' (project GID) OR both 'assignee' AND 'workspace' together.

**Input schema:**
```json

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assignee",

    "workspace": {

      "title": "Workspace",
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the workspace. Must be provided together with 'assignee' if 'parent' is not specified."

    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' output."
    }
  }
}

GREEN = 3\n\nAccess them by:\n\n- attribute access::\n\n>>> Color.RED\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- value lookup:\n\n>>> Color(1)\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- name lookup:\n\n>>> Color['RED']\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\nEnumerations can be iterated over, and know how many members they have:\n\n>>> len(Color)\n3\n\n>>> list(Color)\n[<Color.RED: 1>, <Color.BLUE: 2>, <Color.GREEN: 3>]\n\nMethods can be added to enumerations, and members can have their own\nattributes -- see the documentation for details."

                    "description": "Create a collection of name/value pairs.\n\nExample enumeration:\n\n>>> class Color(Enum):\n...     RED = 1\n...     BLUE = 2\n...     GREEN = 3\n\nAccess them by:\n\n- attribute access::\n\n>>> Color.RED\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- value lookup:\n\n>>> Color(1)\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- name lookup:\n\n>>> Color['RED']\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\nEnumerations can be iterated over, and know how many members they have:\n\n>>> len(Color)\n3\n\n>>> list(Color)\n[<Color.RED: 1>, <Color.BLUE: 2>, <Color.GREEN: 3>]\n\nMethods can be added to enumerations, and members can have their own\nattributes -- see the documentation for details."

GREEN = 3\n\nAccess them by:\n\n- attribute access::\n\n>>> Color.RED\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- value lookup:\n\n>>> Color(1)\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- name lookup:\n\n>>> Color['RED']\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\nEnumerations can be iterated over, and know how many members they have:\n\n>>> len(Color)\n3\n\n>>> list(Color)\n[<Color.RED: 1>, <Color.BLUE: 2>, <Color.GREEN: 3>]\n\nMethods can be added to enumerations, and members can have their own\nattributes -- see the documentation for details."

                        "description": "Create a collection of name/value pairs.\n\nExample enumeration:\n\n>>> class Color(Enum):\n...     RED = 1\n...     BLUE = 2\n...     GREEN = 3\n\nAccess them by:\n\n- attribute access::\n\n>>> Color.RED\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- value lookup:\n\n>>> Color(1)\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\n- name lookup:\n\n>>> Color['RED']\n<Color.RED: 1>\n\nEnumerations can be iterated over, and know how many members they have:\n\n>>> len(Color)\n3\n\n>>> list(Color)\n[<Color.RED: 1>, <Color.BLUE: 2>, <Color.GREEN: 3>]\n\nMethods can be added to enumerations, and members can have their own\nattributes -- see the documentation for details."

## ASANA_GET_A_TASK
Retrieves full details for a specified task GID accessible by the user; use `opt_fields` to customize returned data.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",

## ASANA_GET_AUDIT_LOG_EVENTS
Tool to get audit log events for a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve a log of actions performed within a specific Asana workspace.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAuditLogEventsRequest",
  "required": [
    "workspace_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        50
      ],
      "description": "Results per page. The number of objects to return per page. The value must be between 1 and 100."
    },
    "end_at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "examples": [
        "2023-10-27T10:00:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "Filter to events created before this time (exclusive)."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "examples": [
        "abcdef123456"
      ],
      "description": "Offset token. An offset to the next page returned by the API. A pagination request will return an offset token, which can be used as an input parameter to the next request. If an offset is not passed in, the API will return the first page of results."
    },
    "start_at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "examples": [
        "2023-10-26T10:00:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "Filter to events created after this time (inclusive)."
    },
    "actor_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Actor Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Filter to events triggered by the actor with this ID."
    },
    "actor_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Actor Type",
      "examples": [
        "user"
      ],
      "description": "Filter to events with an actor of this type. This only needs to be included if querying for actor types without an ID. If actor_gid is included, this should be excluded."
    },
    "event_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Type",
      "examples": [
        "task_created"
      ],
      "description": "Filter to events of this type. Refer to the supported audit log events for a full list of values."
    },
    "resource_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Resource Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Filter to events with this resource ID."
    },
    "workspace_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the workspace or organization."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_GET_A_USER_TASK_LIST
Retrieves a specific user's task list from Asana by its `user_task_list_gid`, optionally returning extended details like name, owner, and workspace if specified in `opt_fields`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAUserTaskListRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_task_list_gid",
    "workspace"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "workspace": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace",
      "examples": [
        "1205766922013215"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the workspace to filter the user task list."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "name",
          "owner",
          "workspace"
        ],
        "type": "string",
        "title": "OptFieldsEnm0"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        "name",
        "owner",
        "workspace"
      ],
      "description": "A list of optional field names to include in the response. By default, the response is compact and excludes some properties. Use this parameter to retrieve additional details. For example, to include the owner and workspace, provide `[\"owner\", \"workspace\"]` as the value for this field."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Set to true to receive the API response in a pretty-printed JSON format. This is useful for debugging but may increase response size and processing time."
    },
    "user_task_list_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Task List Gid",
      "examples": [

      "description": "The user GID (not task list GID) to retrieve the task list for. This endpoint retrieves a user's task list by user GID, not by task list GID. Use 'me' for the authenticated user or a specific user GID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `GetAUserTaskList`"
}

## ASANA_GET_CUSTOM_FIELDS_FOR_WORKSPACE
Tool to get all custom fields in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve a list of custom fields associated with a specific workspace.

## ASANA_GET_CUSTOM_TYPES
Tool to get all custom types associated with a project. Use when you need to retrieve custom types that extend Asana objects for categorization purposes.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCustomTypesRequest",
  "required": [
    "project"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        50
      ],
      "description": "Results per page. The number of objects to return per page. The value must be between 1 and 100."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "examples": [
        "eyJ0eXAiOJiKV1iQLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9"
      ],
      "description": "Offset token. An offset to the next page returned by the API. A pagination request will return an offset token, which can be used as an input parameter to the next request. If an offset is not passed in, the API will return the first page of results."
    },
    "project": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project",
      "examples": [
        "1331"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the project, which is used as a filter when retrieving all custom types."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "name",
          "status_options",
          "status_options.color"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides \"pretty\" output. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_GET_EVENTS
Retrieve events on a resource to monitor changes. Use when you need to track activity or changes related to a specific Asana resource like a task, project, or tag.

**Input schema:**

      "description": "A sync token received from a previous events GET request. If provided, the API will return only events that have occurred since the sync token was created. If omitted, the API will return all events."

    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",

          "action",
          "resource",
          "parent",
          "created_at"
        ]

Other times requests return more information than you may need. This option allows you to list the exact set of fields that the API should be sure to return for the objects. The field names should be provided as paths, described below. The id of included objects will always be returned, regardless of the field options."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",

      "description": "Provides \u201cpretty\u201d output. Provides the response in a \u201cpretty\u201d format. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable.       "type": "string",

      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the resource."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_GET_GOAL_RELATIONSHIPS
Tool to retrieve goal relationships. Use when you need to get the relationships associated with a specific goal in Asana.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "required": [
    "goal_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "examples": [

      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },

      "examples": [

        ]

      "type": "boolean",

  }
}

## ASANA_GET_GOALS
Tool to retrieve multiple goals. Requires exactly one scope parameter (workspace, team, portfolio, or project) to be specified. Can be optionally filtered by time period or archived status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetGoalsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "team": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team",
      "examples": [
        "14916"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the team. Exactly one of workspace, team, portfolio, or project must be specified."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [
        20
      ],
      "description": "The number of results to return."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "examples": [
        "abcdefg"
      ],
      "description": "Offset token for pagination."
    },
    "project": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the project. Exactly one of workspace, team, portfolio, or project must be specified."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "examples": [
        false
      ],
      "description": "Filter to archived goals."
    },
    "portfolio": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Portfolio",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the portfolio. Exactly one of workspace, team, portfolio, or project must be specified."
    },
    "workspace": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the workspace or organization. Exactly one of workspace, team, portfolio, or project must be specified."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "description": "Defines fields to return. Some requests support structured objects supporting cascades of multiple objects separated by commas; \"data.gid\" will return the gid field of the data object or \"data.subtask.gid\" will return the gid field of the subtask object."
    },
    "time_period": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Time Period",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the time period."
    },
    "is_workspace_level": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Workspace Level",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Filter to goals at the workspace level."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_GET_JOB
Tool to retrieve a job by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to check the status of asynchronous operations like task duplication, project instantiation, or exports.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetJobRequest",
  "required": [
    "job_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "job_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Job Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the job."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "new_graph_export",
          "new_graph_export.completed_at",
          "new_graph_export.created_at",
          "new_graph_export.download_url",
          "new_project",
          "new_project.name",
          "new_project_template",
          "new_project_template.name",
          "new_resource_export",
          "new_resource_export.completed_at",
          "new_resource_export.created_at",
          "new_resource_export.download_url",
          "new_task",
          "new_task.created_by",
          "new_task.name",
          "new_task.resource_subtype",
          "resource_subtype",
          "status"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of properties to include in the response. This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "If true, provides \"pretty\" (i.e., human-readable) JSON output. Formatting dates and times as human-readable strings, numbers as strings, and including newlines and indentation."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_GET_MEMBERSHIPS
Tool to retrieve memberships for goals, projects, portfolios, or custom fields. Use this to find out who has access to a specific Asana resource or what resources a specific user/team has access to.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetMembershipsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        20
      ],
      "description": "The number of results to return per page."
    },
    "member": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Member",
      "examples": [
        "67890"
      ],
      "description": "GID of the member (user or team) to filter memberships."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "examples": [
        "eyJ0eXAiOJiKV1iQLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..."
      ],
      "description": "Offset token for pagination."
    },
    "parent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "GID of the parent resource (e.g., project_gid, goal_gid, portfolio_gid, or custom_field_gid) to filter memberships."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        "parent,member,access_level,parent.name,member.name"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response (e.g., \"parent,member,access_level,parent.name,member.name\")."
    }
  }
}

## ASANA_GET_MULTIPLE_TASKS
Retrieves a list of tasks, allowing filtering by assignee (requires `workspace`), project, section, `completed_since`, and `modified_since`; `workspace` also requires `assignee`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetMultipleTasksRequest",
  "properties": {
    "tag": {
      "type": "string",

      "pattern": "^[0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890"
      ],
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Tag GID to filter tasks. Mutually exclusive with project, section, user_task_list, or assignee+workspace."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        20,
        50,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Number of task objects to return per page (1-100). Required when using assignee+workspace; defaults to 50 if omitted for that filter combination."

    "offset": {
      "type": "string",

    "project": {

  "additionalProperties": true
}

## ASANA_GET_MULTIPLE_USERS
Returns a list of users in an Asana workspace or organization, optionally filtered by workspace or team GID, with support for pagination and specifying optional fields.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetMultipleUsersRequest",
  "properties": {
    "team": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team",
      "examples": [
        "112233445566778"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the Asana team. Required when the authenticated user belongs to multiple workspaces (at least one of 'workspace' or 'team' must be provided). Filters results to users in this team."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "description": "The maximum number of user objects to return per page (1-100)."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "description": "Opaque token for pagination to retrieve the subsequent page of results."
    },
    "workspace": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace",
      "examples": [
        "123456789012345"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the Asana workspace or organization. Required when the authenticated user belongs to multiple workspaces (at least one of 'workspace' or 'team' must be provided). Filters results to users in this workspace."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "email",
          "name",
          "offset",
          "path",
          "photo",
          "photo.image_1024x1024",
          "photo.image_128x128",
          "photo.image_21x21",
          "photo.image_27x27",
          "photo.image_36x36",
          "photo.image_60x60",
          "uri",
          "workspaces",
          "workspaces.name"
        ],
        "type": "string",
        "title": "OptFieldsEnm0"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "email",
          "name",
          "photo.image_128x128",
          "workspaces.name"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A list of optional field names to include in the response for each user. Available fields include 'email', 'name', 'photo' (and its specific sizes like 'photo.image_1024x1024'), 'workspaces', 'uri', and 'offset'."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Return the response in a human-readable JSON format."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters to filter and paginate the list of users.\n\nAt least one of 'workspace' or 'team' must be provided when the authenticated user belongs to multiple workspaces."
}
