## ASANA_GET_PORTFOLIO_ITEMS
Retrieve items in a portfolio. Use this to get a list of projects or other portfolios contained within a specific portfolio.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPortfolioItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "portfolio_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        20
      ],
      "description": "Number of results to return per page."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "examples": [
        "eyJ0eXAiOJiKV1iQLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9"
      ],
      "description": "Offset token to request next page."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "name",
          "owner",
          "due_on"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Fields to include in response. Common fields: archived, color, created_at, current_status_update, due_on, members, name, notes, owner, start_on, team, workspace."
    },
    "portfolio_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Portfolio Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the portfolio."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_GET_PORTFOLIO_MEMBERSHIPS
Tool to retrieve multiple portfolio memberships. Use this tool when you need to list memberships for a specific portfolio, a user within a portfolio, or a user across all portfolios in a workspace.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPortfolioMembershipsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "user": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "test@example.com",
        "1112233"
      ],
      "description": "A string identifying a user. This can either be the string \"me\", an email, or the GID of a user."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Results per page. The number of objects to return per page. Must be between 1 and 100, inclusive."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "examples": [
        "eyJ0eXAiOJiKV1iQLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9"
      ],
      "description": "Offset token. An offset to paginate from. This can be retrieved from the \u2018next_page\u2019 field in the previous response."
    },
    "portfolio": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Portfolio",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the portfolio to filter memberships on."
    },
    "workspace": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace",
      "examples": [
        "67890"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the workspace to filter memberships on."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "user.name",
          "portfolio.name",
          "workspace"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Defines fields to return. Some requests return compact representations of objects in order to conserve resources and complete the request more efficiently. Other times requests return more information than you may need. This option allows you to list the exact set of fields that the API should be sure to return for the objects. The field names should be provided as paths, described below. The id of included objects will always be returned, regardless of the field options."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_GET_PORTFOLIOS
Retrieve multiple portfolios. Use when you need to list portfolios within a specific workspace, optionally filtered by owner.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPortfoliosRequest",
  "required": [
    "workspace",
    "owner"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The number of objects to return per page. Must be between 1 and 100."
    },
    "owner": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner",
      "description": "The user GID who owns the portfolio. Use 'me' to refer to the current authenticated user. This parameter is required by the Asana API."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "description": "An offset token for pagination."
    },
    "workspace": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace",
      "description": "The workspace or organization GID to filter portfolios on. Must be a non-empty numeric GID (e.g., '1205766922013215')."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "description": "Fields to include in the response. For example: ['name', 'color', 'owner']."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_GET_PROJECT_BRIEF
Tool to retrieve a project brief by its GID. Use when you need to get the detailed explanation (what and why) of a project. Note: Requires the project_brief_gid (not the project_gid). First call 'Get a project' with opt_fields=['project_brief'] to obtain the project_brief_gid.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetProjectBriefRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_brief_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include. Available options: text"
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' output. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    },
    "project_brief_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Brief Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1212598676699299"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the project brief. This is NOT the project GID. Must be a numeric string. To obtain a project_brief_gid, first call 'Get a project' with opt_fields=['project_brief'] to retrieve the project's brief object, which contains the project_brief_gid."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_GET_PROJECT_MEMBERSHIPS
Tool to get memberships from a specific project. Use when you need to see who has access to a project and their permission levels.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetProjectMembershipsRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user": {
```

## ASANA_GET_PROJECT_TEMPLATES
Tool to retrieve multiple project templates. Use when you need to list available project templates in a workspace or team.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetProjectTemplatesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        20
      ],
      "description": "Results per page. The number of objects to return per page. The value must be between 1 and 100."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "examples": [
        "eyJ0eXAiOJiKV1iQLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9"
      ],
      "description": "Offset token. An offset to the next page returned by the API. A pagination request will return an offset token, which can be used as an input parameter to the next request."
    },
    "team_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Gid",
      "examples": [
        "14916"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the team. Recommended when working with organizations. REQUIRED: At least one of workspace_gid or team_gid must be provided. Accepts both 'team_gid' and 'team' as parameter names."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "name",
          "description",
          "owner"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. For example: name,description,owner,team,public"
    },
    "workspace_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for a regular workspace (not an organization). Only accepts workspace GIDs - organization GIDs will be rejected. For organizations, use team_gid instead. REQUIRED: At least one of workspace_gid or team_gid must be provided. Accepts both 'workspace_gid' and 'workspace' as parameter names."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_GET_REACTIONS_ON_OBJECT
Tool to get reactions with a specific emoji base character on an object. Use when you need to retrieve user reactions (emoji responses) on a status update or story.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetReactionsOnObjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "target",
    "emoji_base"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        50
      ],
      "description": "Results per page. The number of objects to return per page. The value must be between 1 and 100."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "examples": [
        "eyJ0eXAiOJiKV1iQLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9"
      ],
      "description": "Offset token. An offset to the next page returned by the API. A pagination request will return an offset token, which can be used as an input parameter to the next request. If an offset is not passed in, the API will return the first page of results."
    },
    "target": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Target",
      "examples": [
        "1212887201183176"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for object to fetch reactions from. Must be a GID for a status update or story."
    },
    "emoji_base": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Emoji Base",
      "examples": [
        "\ud83d\udc4d"
      ],
      "description": "Only return reactions with this emoji base character."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' output. Provides the response in a 'pretty' format. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_GET_TAGS_FOR_TASK

## ASANA_GET_TAGS_FOR_WORKSPACE
Tool to get all tags in a specific workspace. Use when you need to retrieve tags for categorizing tasks within a workspace.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTagsForWorkspaceRequest",
  "required": [
    "workspace_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        50
      ],
      "description": "Results per page. The number of objects to return per page. The value must be between 1 and 100."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "examples": [
        "eyJ0eXAiOJiKV1iQLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9"
      ],
      "description": "Offset token. An offset to the next page returned by the API. A pagination request will return an offset token, which can be used as an input parameter to the next request."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "color",
          "created_at",
          "followers",
          "followers.name",
          "name",
          "notes",
          "permalink_url",
          "workspace",
          "workspace.name"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include."

    "workspace_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the workspace or organization."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_GET_TASK_ATTACHMENTS
Tool to get the list of attachments for a given task, project, or project_brief. Use when you need to retrieve files attached to a specific Asana object.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTaskAttachmentsRequest",
  "required": [
    "parent_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        20
      ],
      "description": "The number of results per page."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "examples": [
        "eyJ0eXAiOJiKV1iQLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9"
      ],
      "description": "An offset token, used for pagination to retrieve the next page of results. If not provided or empty, the first page of results is returned."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "name",
          "download_url",
          "parent.name"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of fields to include in the response for each attachment. Possible fields include: `created_at`, `download_url`, `host`, `name`, `parent`, `parent.name`, `permanent_url`, `resource_subtype`, `size`, `view_url`."
    },
    "parent_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1205766923323569"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the task, project, or project_brief to fetch attachments from."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_GET_TIME_PERIODS
Tool to retrieve compact or full representations of time periods. Use this when you need to fetch information about specific time periods, such as their start and end dates, display names, and parent periods.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTimePeriodsRequest",
  "required": [
    "workspace_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Results per page."
    },
    "end_on": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End On",
      "pattern": "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$",
      "description": "The last day of the time period, YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offset",
      "description": "Offset token for pagination."
    },
    "start_on": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start On",
      "pattern": "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$",
      "description": "The first day of the time period, YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "gid",
          "resource_type",
          "start_on",
          "end_on",
          "period",
          "display_name",
          "parent"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of fields to include in the response."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides the response in \"pretty\" output."
    },
    "workspace_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the workspace."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_GET_TIME_TRACKING_ENTRIES
Tool to get multiple time tracking entries across workspace, tasks, or projects. Use when you need to retrieve time tracking information for filtering by workspace, task, portfolio, user, or date range.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "title": "GetTimeTrackingEntriesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "task": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the task to filter time tracking entries by."
    },

      "type": "string",
      "title": "User",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the user to filter time tracking entries by."
    },

      "title": "Limit",
      "examples": [

      ],

If an offset is not passed in, the API will return the first page of results. *Note: You can only pass in an offset that was returned to you via a previously paginated request.*"
    },
```

## ASANA_GET_TYPEAHEAD_OBJECTS
Tool to retrieve objects in a workspace via a typeahead search algorithm. Use when you need to quickly find objects like tasks, projects, users, etc., based on a search string. This is useful for implementing auto-completion features.

```json
    "workspace_gid"

      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10
      ],

    },

      "type": "string",

        "John Doe"
      ],
      "description": "The string that will be used to search for relevant objects. If an empty string is passed in, the API will return results."
```

## ASANA_GET_USER_FOR_WORKSPACE
Tool to get a user in a workspace or organization by their GID. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific user within a workspace context.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetUserForWorkspaceRequest",
  "required": [
    "workspace_gid",
    "user_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Gid",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "12345",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "A string identifying a user. This can either be the string \"me\", an email, or the gid of a user."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "email",
          "name",
          "photo",
          "workspaces"
        ],
        "type": "string",
        "title": "OptFieldsUser"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides \"pretty\" output. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    },
    "workspace_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the workspace or organization."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_GET_WEBHOOKS
Tool to retrieve multiple webhooks in a workspace. Use when you need to list all webhooks for a workspace or filter webhooks by a specific resource.

## ASANA_GET_WORKSPACE
Tool to retrieve details of a specific workspace by its GID. Use when you need to get information about a particular Asana workspace.

**Input schema:**

```json
    "workspace_gid"

          "name",
          "email_domains"

}
```

## ASANA_GET_WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIPS
Tool to retrieve the workspace memberships for a specific workspace. Use when you need to list members of a workspace.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetWorkspaceMembershipsRequest",
  "required": [
    "workspace_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "12345",
        "test@example.com"

      "items": {
        "type": "string"

          "user.name",
          "workspace.name",
          "is_active"

Other times requests return more information than you may need. This option allows you to list the exact set of fields that the API should return for each object.       "title": "Workspace Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the workspace."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_GET_WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIPS_FOR_USER
Tool to retrieve workspace memberships for a specific user. Use when you need to list all workspaces a user is a member of.

## ASANA_INSERT_ENUM_OPTION_FOR_CUSTOM_FIELD
Tool to reorder an existing enum option within a custom field by moving it before or after another specified enum option. Use when you need to change the order/position of options in an enum or multi_enum custom field. Note: To create new enum options, use 'Create Enum Option for Custom Field' action instead.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "InsertEnumOptionForCustomFieldRequest",
  "required": [
    "custom_field_gid",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "enum_option"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enum_option": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Enum Option",
          "examples": [
            "1234567890123456"
          ],
          "description": "The GID of an existing enum option to move/reorder within the custom field."
        },
        "insert_after": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Insert After",
          "examples": [
            "1122334455667788"
          ],
          "description": "GID of an existing enum option after which the specified enum_option should be inserted. One of 'insert_before' or 'insert_after' must be provided, but not both."
        },
        "insert_before": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Insert Before",
          "examples": [
            "0987654321098765"
          ],
          "description": "GID of an existing enum option before which the specified enum_option should be inserted. One of 'insert_before' or 'insert_after' must be provided, but not both."
        }
      },
      "description": "The data for the enum option to be inserted or reordered.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "name",
          "color",
          "enabled"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Provides \u201cpretty\u201d output."
    },
    "custom_field_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Custom Field Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the custom field."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_INSERT_SECTION_FOR_PROJECT
Tool to move or reorder an existing section within a project by repositioning it before or after another section. Use when you need to change the position/order of sections in a project. Note: This action moves existing sections only. To create new sections, use 'Create Section in Project' action instead.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "InsertSectionForProjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_gid",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "section"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "section": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Section",
          "examples": [
            "1212991674592592",
            "321654"
          ],
          "description": "The GID of the section to reorder/move within the project."
        },
        "after_section": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "After Section",
          "examples": [
            "1210124791807962",
            "987654"
          ],
          "description": "Insert the given section immediately after the section specified by this parameter. One of 'after_section' or 'before_section' must be provided, but not both."
        },
        "before_section": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Before Section",
          "examples": [
            "86420"
          ],
          "description": "Insert the given section immediately before the section specified by this parameter. One of 'after_section' or 'before_section' must be provided, but not both."
        }
      },
      "description": "The data specifying which section to move and where to position it.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides \"pretty\" output. Provides the response in a \"pretty\" format. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    },
    "project_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1210124791807961",
        "1331"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the project."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_INSTANTIATE_PROJECT_TEMPLATE
Instantiate (create) a real Asana project from a project template, returning the async job record. Use when you need to create a new project from a template with specific date and role assignments.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "InstantiateProjectTemplateRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_template_gid",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Q1 Marketing Campaign",
        "New Product Launch"
      ],
      "description": "The name for the new project that will be created from the template."
    },
    "team": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team",
      "examples": [
        "67890",
        "team_gid_123"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the team that the new project will belong to. Required if the template is a team template."
    },
    "is_strict": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Strict",
      "description": "If true, requires all date and role variables from the template to be provided. If false or omitted, missing variables will use defaults."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "gid",
          "status",
          "new_project",
          "new_project_template"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Optional fields to include in the response. Common values: gid, status, new_project, new_project_template."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "If true, returns human-readable JSON response (for debugging only due to size/processing impact)."
    },
    "privacy_setting": {
      "enum": [
        "public_to_workspace",
        "private_to_team",
        "private"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "PrivacySetting",
      "examples": [
        "public_to_workspace",
        "private_to_team",
        "private"
      ],
      "description": "Privacy setting for the new project. If not specified, inherits from template or team settings."
    },
    "requested_dates": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "RequestedDate",
        "required": [
          "gid",
          "value"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "gid": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Gid",
            "examples": [
              "1",
              "2",
              "123456789"
            ],
            "description": "GID of the date variable from the template. Common values: '1' for start date, '2' for due date, or a custom variable GID."
          },
          "value": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Value",
            "examples": [
              "2024-12-31",
              "2025-01-15"
            ],
            "description": "The date value in YYYY-MM-DD format to assign to this date variable."
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Requested Dates",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "gid": "1",
            "value": "2024-12-31"
          },
          {
            "gid": "2",
            "value": "2025-01-15"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of date variable assignments. Required if the template includes date variables and is_strict is true."
    },
    "requested_roles": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "RequestedRole",
        "required": [
          "gid",
          "value"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "gid": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Gid",
            "examples": [
              "987654321",
              "123456789"
            ],
            "description": "GID of the template role to assign a user to."
          },
          "value": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Value",
            "examples": [
              "user_gid_12345",
              "67890"
            ],
            "description": "GID of the user to assign to this role."
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Requested Roles",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "gid": "role_gid_123",
            "value": "user_gid_456"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of role assignments mapping template roles to specific users."
    },
    "project_template_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Template Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "987654321"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the project template to instantiate."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_SET_PARENT_FOR_TASK
Tool to set the parent of a task in Asana. Use when you need to make a task a subtask of another task or remove the parent relationship.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SetParentForTaskRequest",
  "required": [
    "task_gid",
    "parent"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "parent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent",
      "examples": [
        "1213187208675417",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the new parent task, or 'null' to remove the parent. Setting a parent makes this task a subtask of the parent."
    },
    "task_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1213245048982427"
      ],
      "description": "The globally unique identifier (GID) of the task to set the parent for."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        "name,parent,parent.name,resource_subtype"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. By default, the response returns a compact representation of the task. Use this to retrieve additional fields such as 'name', 'parent', 'parent.name', etc."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' output with proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    },
    "insert_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert After",
      "examples": [
        "124816",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "A subtask GID of the parent to insert the task after, or 'null' to insert at the beginning of the subtask list. If not provided, the task will be inserted at an appropriate position."
    },
    "insert_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert Before",
      "examples": [
        "124816",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "A subtask GID of the parent to insert the task before, or 'null' to insert at the end of the subtask list. If not provided, the task will be inserted at an appropriate position."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_SUBMIT_PARALLEL_REQUESTS
Tool to submit multiple Asana API requests in parallel using the Batch API. Use when you need to perform several operations efficiently, such as fetching multiple tasks or creating multiple subtasks at once.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SubmitParallelRequestsRequest",
  "required": [
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "actions"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "actions": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",

            "required": [
              "method",
              "relative_path"
            ],
            "properties": {

                    "name": "New Task Name"

                  "post",
                  "put",
                  "delete",

                ],

                "title": "Method",
                "examples": [
                  "get"
                ],
                "description": "The HTTP method for the action (e.g., get, post, put, delete)."
              },

                "type": "object",
                "title": "Options",

                  }
                ],
                "description": "Additional options such as fields to return or pagination parameters. Example: {\"opt_fields\": \"name,assignee\"}",
                "additionalProperties": true
              },
              "relative_path": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Relative Path",
                "examples": [
                  "/tasks/12345"
                ],
                "description": "The endpoint path relative to the API base URL. Example: /tasks/123"

            }
          },
          "title": "Actions",
          "maxItems": 10,
          "minItems": 1,
          "description": "A list of action objects, each representing a standard request to an existing Asana API endpoint."

      },

      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_ALLOCATION
Tool to update an existing allocation by its ID. Use this when you need to modify details like the start date, end date, effort, or assignee for an allocation.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateAllocationRequest",
  "required": [
    "allocation_gid",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "effort": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Effort",
          "required": [
            "value",
            "unit"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "unit": {
              "enum": [
                "percent",
                "hours"
              ],
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Unit",
              "description": "The unit of the effort, either 'percent' or 'hours'."
            },
            "value": {
              "type": "number",
              "title": "Value",
              "description": "The value of the effort, e.g., 20 for 20% or 5 for 5 hours."
            }
          },
          "description": "The amount of time associated with the allocation.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "assignee": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Assignee",
          "description": "The GID of the user or placeholder to assign to the allocation."
        },
        "end_date": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "End Date",
          "format": "date",
          "description": "The new localized day on which the allocation ends (YYYY-MM-DD)."
        },
        "start_date": {
          "type": "string",
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_A_TASK
Updates attributes of an existing Asana task identified by its task_gid.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateATaskRequest",
  "required": [
    "task_gid",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "Review quarterly report",
            "Finalize presentation draft"
          ],
          "description": "Name of the task. This is generally a short sentence fragment that fits on a line in the UI for maximum readability, but it can be longer. Optional for updates - Asana allows partial updates."
        },
        "liked": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Liked",
          "description": "True if the task is liked by the authorized user, false if not."
        },
        "notes": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Notes",
          "examples": [
            "This is a critical task for the project launch.",
            "Follow up with marketing team."
          ],
          "description": "Free-form textual information associated with the task (i.e., its description)."
        },
        "due_at": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Due At",
          "examples": [
            "2023-09-15T02:06:58.147Z"
          ],
          "description": "The UTC date and time on which this task is due (e.g., '2023-09-15T02:06:58.147Z'). Null if the task has no due time. This takes an ISO 8601 date string and should not be used together with `due_on`."
        },
        "due_on": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Due On",
          "examples": [
            "2023-09-15"
          ],
          "description": "The localized date on which this task is due (e.g., '2023-09-15'). Null if the task has no due date. This takes a date with YYYY-MM-DD format and should not be used together with `due_at`."
        },
        "assignee": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Assignee",
          "examples": [
            "1234567890123",
            "me",
            "user@example.com"
          ],
          "description": "The GID of the user to assign the task to. Can be the string 'me' to assign to the authenticated user, or an email address."
        },
        "start_at": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Start At",
          "examples": [
            "2023-09-14T09:00:00.000Z"
          ],
          "description": "The UTC date and time on which work begins for the task (e.g., '2023-09-14T09:00:00.000Z'). Null if the task has no start time. This takes an ISO 8601 date string in UTC and should not be used together with `start_on`. *Note: `due_at` must be present in the request when setting or unsetting the `start_at` parameter.*"
        },
        "start_on": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Start On",
          "examples": [
            "2023-09-14"
          ],
          "description": "The localized date on which work begins for the task (e.g., '2023-09-14'). Null if the task has no start date. This takes a date with YYYY-MM-DD format and should not be used together with `start_at`. *Note: `due_on` or `due_at` must be present in the request when setting or unsetting the `start_on` parameter.*"
        },
        "completed": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Completed",
          "description": "True if the task is currently marked complete, false if not."
        },
        "workspace": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Workspace",
          "examples": [
            "30001"
          ],
          "description": "The GID of the workspace to associate the task with. This is usually only required if the task is being moved between workspaces, which is a rare operation."
        },
        "html_notes": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Html Notes",
          "examples": [
            "<body><strong>Important:</strong> Please review by EOD.</body>"
          ],
          "description": "The notes of the task with rich text formatting. Content is automatically converted to Asana-compatible XML. Supported tags: <strong>, <em>, <u>, <s>, <code>, <pre>, <blockquote>, <ol>, <ul>, <li>, <a>, <h1>, <h2>, <hr/>. Note: <br> tags are auto-converted to newlines (not supported by Asana). <b> and <i> are converted to <strong> and <em>. Unsupported tags (div, span, p, etc.) are stripped but their content is preserved. Ampersands (&) are auto-escaped to &amp;. Content is auto-wrapped in <body> tags if not present."
        },
        "custom_type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Custom Type",
          "examples": [
            "40001"
          ],
          "description": "The GID of the custom type for the task. This is relevant for tasks using specific task type configurations."
        },
        "custom_fields": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Custom Fields",
          "examples": [
            {
              "custom_field_gid_1": "enum_option_gid",
              "custom_field_gid_2": "new text value",
              "custom_field_gid_3": 12345,
              "date_custom_field_gid": "2024-08-23",
              "datetime_custom_field_gid": "2024-08-23T22:00:00.000Z"
            }
          ],
          "description": "An object (not a JSON string) where each key is the GID of a custom field and its corresponding value is the new value for that custom field. The value can be an enum GID, string, number, object, or array, depending on the custom field type. For date-type custom fields, you can pass: (1) a plain date string 'YYYY-MM-DD' which will be converted to {'date': 'YYYY-MM-DD'}, (2) an ISO 8601 datetime string like '2024-08-23T22:00:00.000Z' which will be converted to {'date_time': 'ISO-string'}, or (3) a properly formatted object with either 'date' OR 'date_time' key (not both). Use ASANA_GET_CUSTOM_FIELDS_FOR_WORKSPACE to fetch available custom fields for your workspace.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        },
        "approval_status": {
          "enum": [
            "pending",
            "approved",
            "rejected",
            "changes_requested"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "ApprovalStatus",
          "description": "Reflects the approval status of this task. This field is kept in sync with `completed`, meaning `pending` translates to false while `approved`, `rejected`, and `changes_requested` translate to true. If you set `completed` to true, this field will be set to `approved`."
        },
        "assignee_status": {
          "enum": [
            "today",
            "upcoming",
            "later",
            "new",
            "inbox"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "AssigneeStatus",
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_CUSTOM_FIELD
Tool to update a custom field by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to modify properties of an existing custom field in Asana.

**Input schema:**
```json

          "enum_options"

      ],

      "type": "string",

  }
}
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_PROJECT
Update a project.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateProjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "New Project Name"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the project. Note: User task lists (My Tasks) are special system-managed projects whose names cannot be changed. Attempting to rename a user task list will result in an error."
    },
    "team": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the team that this project is shared with."
    },
    "color": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Color",
      "examples": [
        "light-green"
      ],
      "description": "Color of the project."
    },
    "notes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Notes",
      "examples": [
        "This is a new description for the project."
      ],
      "description": "Free-form textual information associated with the project (its description)."
    },
    "owner": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the new owner of the project. May be null."
    },
    "due_on": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Due On",
      "examples": [
        "2023-12-31"
      ],
      "description": "The day on which this project is due. This takes a date with format YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "public": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Public",
      "description": "True if the project is public to its team."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "description": "True if the project is archived, false if not."
    },
    "due_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Due Date",
      "examples": [
        "2023-12-31"
      ],
      "description": "The localized day on which this project is due. This takes a date with format YYYY-MM-DD."
    },
    "start_on": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start On",
      "examples": [
        "2023-01-01"
      ],
      "description": "The day on which work for this project begins, or null if the project has no start date. This takes a date with YYYY-MM-DD format."
    },
    "html_notes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Html Notes",
      "examples": [
        "<body>This is a new description for the project.</body>"
      ],
      "description": "[Opt In](/docs/input-output-options). The notes of the project with formatting as HTML."
    },
    "is_template": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Template",
      "description": "[Opt In](/docs/input-output-options). True if the project is a template."
    },
    "project_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "The GID of the project to update."
    },
    "default_view": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Default View",
      "examples": [
        "list"
      ],
      "description": "The default view (list, board, calendar, or timeline) of a project."
    },
    "custom_fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "123": "value1",
          "456": "value2"
        }
      ],
      "description": "An object where each key is the GID of a custom field and its corresponding value is the new value for that custom field.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_PROJECT_BRIEF
Tool to update a project brief by its GID. Use when you need to modify the content/description of a project brief. Note: Requires the project_brief_gid (not the project_gid). First call 'Get a project' with opt_fields=['project_brief'] to obtain the project_brief_gid.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateProjectBriefRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_brief_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "text": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Text",
      "examples": [
        "Updated project brief text - Testing the UPDATE_PROJECT_BRIEF endpoint with valid authentication and parameters."
      ],
      "description": "The plain text content of the project brief. This field updates the main content/description of the project brief."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include. Available options: html_text, permalink_url, project, project.name, text, title"
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' output. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    },
    "project_brief_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Brief Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1212598676699299"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the project brief. This is NOT the project GID. Must be a numeric string. To obtain a project_brief_gid, first call 'Get a project' with opt_fields=['project_brief'] to retrieve the project's brief object, which contains the project_brief_gid."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_SECTION
Update a section's name or position within a project. Use when you need to rename a section or reorder sections by specifying insert_before or insert_after.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateSectionRequest",
  "required": [
    "section_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Updated To Do Section",
        "In Progress",
        "Done"
      ],
      "description": "The new name for the section. This is the text displayed as the section header. Cannot be an empty string."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "created_at",
          "name",
          "project",
          "project.name"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' output with proper line breaking and indentation. Advisable only during debugging as it increases response time and size."
    },
    "section_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Section Gid",
      "examples": [
        "321654",
        "1210124791807962"
      ],
      "description": "The globally unique identifier for the section to update."
    },
    "insert_after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert After",
      "examples": [
        "987654"
      ],
      "description": "An existing section within this project after which the section should be inserted. Cannot be provided together with insert_before."
    },
    "insert_before": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Insert Before",
      "examples": [
        "86420"
      ],
      "description": "An existing section within this project before which the section should be inserted. Cannot be provided together with insert_after."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_STORY
Tool to update a story on a task. Use when you need to modify the text, html_text, or pin status of an existing story. Only comment stories can have text/html_text updated, and only comment and attachment stories can be pinned.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateStoryRequest",
  "required": [
    "story_gid",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "text": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Text",
          "examples": [
            "This is an updated comment."
          ],
          "description": "The plain text of the comment to add. Cannot be used with html_text. Only applicable for comment stories."
        },
        "html_text": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Html Text",
          "examples": [
            "<body>This is an updated comment.</body>"
          ],
          "description": "HTML formatted text for a comment. This will not include the name of the creator. Cannot be used with text. Only applicable for comment stories."
        },
        "is_pinned": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Is Pinned",
          "examples": [
            false
          ],
          "description": "Whether the story should be pinned on the resource. Only applicable for comment and attachment stories."
        }
      },
      "description": "An object containing the fields of the story to update.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "story_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Story Gid",
      "examples": [
        "35678",
        "1212887201183176"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the story."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "text",
          "created_at",
          "created_by"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides \"pretty\" output. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_TAG
Tool to update an existing tag by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to change the name or color of a tag.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTagRequest",
  "required": [
    "tag_gid",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "The new name of the tag."
        },
        "color": {
          "enum": [
            "dark-pink",
            "dark-green",
            "dark-blue",
            "dark-red",
            "dark-teal",
            "dark-brown",
            "dark-orange",
            "dark-purple",
            "dark-warm-gray",
            "light-pink",
            "light-green",
            "light-blue",
            "light-red",
            "light-teal",
            "light-brown",
            "light-orange",
            "light-purple",
            "light-warm-gray"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "ColorEnum",
          "description": "The new color of the tag."
        }
      },
      "description": "An object containing the fields to update.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "tag_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tag Gid",
      "description": "The globally unique identifier for the tag."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_TEAM
Tool to update details of an existing team. Use when you need to change a team's name, description, or organization.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTeamRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "New Team Name"
      ],
      "description": "The new name of the team."
    },
    "team_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the team."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "description": "Defines fields to return."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides \u201cpretty\u201d output."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "This is the new team description."
      ],
      "description": "The new description of the team."
    },
    "organization": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Organization",
      "examples": [
        "67890"
      ],
      "description": "GID of the organization to which the team belongs. This is the GID of an organization, not its name."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_USER
Update a user's custom fields. Note: Asana's API has very limited user update capabilities - most user properties are read-only and managed by users themselves.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateUserRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Gid",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "12345",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "A string identifying a user. This can either be the string \"me\", an email, or the gid of a user."
    },
    "workspace": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "The workspace to filter results on."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "email",
          "name",
          "photo",
          "workspaces"
        ],
        "type": "string",
        "title": "OptFieldsUser"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides 'pretty' output. Provides the response in a 'pretty' format. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable."
    },
    "custom_fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "1234567890": "Updated value"
        }
      ],
      "description": "An object where each key is a custom field GID and the value is the new value for that custom field. Note: User objects have very limited update capabilities in Asana's API.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          {
            "type": "number"
          },
          {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": true
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_USER_FOR_WORKSPACE
Tool to update a user in a workspace or organization. Use when you need to modify user-specific custom field values for a workspace.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateUserForWorkspaceRequest",
  "required": [
    "workspace_gid",
    "user_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "me",
        "test@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "A string identifying a user. This can either be the string \"me\", an email, or the gid of a user."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "email",
          "name",
          "photo",
          "workspaces"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "This endpoint returns a resource which excludes some properties by default. To include those optional properties, set this query parameter to a comma-separated list of the properties you wish to include."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "description": "Provides \"pretty\" output. In the case of JSON this means doing proper line breaking and indentation to make it readable. This will take extra time and increase the response size so it is advisable only to use this during debugging."
    },
    "custom_fields": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Fields",
      "examples": [
        {
          "1234567890": "option_gid",
          "0987654321": "Some text value"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Object mapping custom field GIDs to their values for the user. Values depend on field type: enum fields use option GIDs (strings), text fields use strings, number fields use numbers.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          {
            "type": "number"
          },
          {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": true
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "workspace_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workspace Gid",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "1205766922013215"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the workspace or organization."
    }
  }
}
```

## ASANA_UPDATE_WEBHOOK
Tool to update an existing Asana webhook's filter configuration. Use when you need to modify which events trigger webhook notifications.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateWebhookRequest",
  "required": [
    "webhook_gid"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "filters": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "WebhookFilter",
        "properties": {
          "action": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Action",
            "examples": [
              "changed",
              "added",
              "removed",
              "deleted",
              "undeleted"
            ],
            "description": "Action type to filter (e.g., 'changed', 'added', 'removed', 'deleted', 'undeleted'). When specified, only events with this action will be delivered."
          },
          "fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Fields",
            "examples": [
              [
                "name",
                "completed"
              ],
              [
                "due_on",
                "assignee",
                "notes"
              ]
            ],
            "description": "Array of field names to filter when action is 'changed'. Only changes to these specific fields will trigger the webhook. Common fields include: 'name', 'completed', 'due_on', 'due_at', 'assignee', 'notes', 'custom_fields'."
          },
          "resource_type": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Resource Type",
            "examples": [
              "task",
              "project",
              "story"
            ],
            "description": "Type of resource to filter (e.g., 'task', 'project', 'story'). When specified, only events for this resource type will be delivered."
          },
          "resource_subtype": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Resource Subtype",
            "examples": [
              "milestone",
              "default_task",
              "approval"
            ],
            "description": "Subtype of resource to filter (e.g., 'milestone', 'default_task', 'approval'). Only relevant when resource_type is specified."
          }
        },
        "description": "Filter object to specify events that should trigger webhook notifications."
      },
      "title": "Filters",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "action": "changed",
            "fields": [
              "name",
              "completed"
            ],
            "resource_type": "task"
          }
        ],
        [
          {
            "resource_type": "task",
            "resource_subtype": "milestone"
          },
          {
            "action": "added",
            "resource_type": "story"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of WebhookFilter objects to specify which events should trigger this webhook. If a webhook event passes any of the filters, the event will be delivered; otherwise no event will be sent. Each filter can specify resource_type, resource_subtype, action, and/or fields to match."
    },
    "opt_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Opt Fields",
      "examples": [
        [
          "active",
          "filters",
          "resource",
          "target"
        ],
        [
          "created_at",
          "last_success_at",
          "last_failure_at"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of optional field names to include in the response. Common fields include: 'active', 'created_at', 'filters', 'last_failure_at', 'last_success_at', 'resource', 'target'."
    },
    "opt_pretty": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Opt Pretty",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, the response JSON will be 'pretty-printed' with indentation and line breaks for readability. Useful for debugging but may increase response time and size."
    },
    "webhook_gid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Webhook Gid",
      "examples": [
        "1213245723496077",
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Globally unique identifier for the webhook to update."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for updating an existing webhook."
}
```
